notes.title: Globesweeper: Hex Puzzler
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34376047/0459ad35a0830d26360d762181f228fb59c4a338.jpg[/img]

Globesweeper: Hex Puzzler takes the spherical minesweeper concept from Globesweeper and twists it into a whole new logic puzzle.

The first thing you will notice is globes are no longer solid, they have gaps everywhere. This instantly creates new patterns to learn, that you need to solve the puzzles. But it doesn't stop there. There are eight new mechanics to learn like X number of mines in a given area or Y number of mines in a chain. With 92 levels to complete, there is so much fun to be had!

Add the game to your wishlist if you want to be notified when the game is released.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121530/Globesweeper_Hex_Puzzler

notes.title: New Globesweeper themes to unlock
notes.content:
A new update for Globesweeper has just been released. It adds two new themes, Mirror Globe and Twitch along with a couple new features.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34376047/83ae94d83f1978999152d75698c3ee56555194a5.png[/img]

A highlighting option has also been added to the game which can be enabled in the options menu. This shows you all adjacent tiles to the tile your cursor is hovering over and is useful if you are finding triangle mode difficult!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34376047/6edd3cf8dc7bb5ba69755a1b9aa978e28883b864.png[/img]

A how to play tutorial has been added to the game intended for new players who have never played a minesweeper game before but it also includes a tutorial on triangle mode which may be useful even for veteran minesweeper players. You can find this in the options menu too.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Mirror theme
[*]Added Twitch theme
[*]Added media links
[*]Added Twitch current streams menu
[*]Added hover highlight option
[*]Added how to play tutorials
[*]Fixed a small issue with normal maps causing inaccurate reflections which was noticeable in the new mirror theme.
[/list]

notes.title: Guaranteed Solvable Now Available
notes.content:
We have been listening to all the great feedback from the community and the top thing people wanted was a guaranteed solvable mode. So it's here, you can now choose guaranteed solvable as one of the generation settings. 

There is also a new mine density setting called insane. In this mode there are as many mines as its possible to cram into a globe while still making it guaranteed solvable. Be warned though this mode is extremely hard.

There is also a lot of quality of life changes which you can find listed below in the patch notes.

Be sure to give us your feedback.

If you think you have found a globe that is not guaranteed solvable be sure to post the seed in the discussions along with a screenshot so I can double check it. You can find the seed in the options menu. 

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added - Guaranteed solvable mode
[*] Added - Insane mine density setting
[*] Added - RMB + LMB area clear
[*] Added - MMB area clear
[*] Added - Highlighting surrounding tiles with RMB + LMB  , MMB or double click
[*] Added - Keyboard controls for playing on laptops
[*] Added - MMB camera rotation
[*] Added - Volume controls
[*] Added - Seed display
[*] Added - 75 new scoreboards (120 total)
[*] Changed - max camera zoom increased
[*] Changed - Stats storage
[*] Fixed - Bug where camera would zoom out on spherified cubes at the corners
[*] Fixed - Possible exploit with game saves
[*]  Fixed - Alt + Enter now maximises the same way as F11
[/list]

notes.title: Podcast: What are our favourite puzzle games?
notes.content:
A ten-sided device appears in your hands. Each side features a carving of a wild animal, but three of the sides depict the face of an RPS writer instead. Look, there s Matt. And yes, this one is John. The side with Brendan is a bit grubby, but it s unmistakeably him. Smells a bit weird. What could this mean? Of course! It s the RPS podcast, the Electronic Wireless Show. Perhaps if you press down on these three journo mugs at the same time aha! A telling click, and the sound of a delicate MP3. You ve discovered the latest episode. They seem to be talking about puzzle games.

notes.title: Wot I Think: Globesweeper
notes.content:
Developer: Incandescent Games
Publisher: Incandescent Games

Release: Out now
On: Windows, Mac, Linux
From: Steam
Price: 2, $2.70, 2

Minesweeper is a terrible puzzle game. It’s not a terrible game! But it’s a terrible puzzle game. Because Minesweeper involves guessing, and that’s fundamentally bad puzzle design. Whether you enjoy playing it comes down to how you approach it. If you’re someone who enjoys methodically solving complicated puzzles using learned techniques (hello!) then Minesweeper is the worst. If you’re someone who loves reaching a certain point where all you can do is blindly click and hope, then it offers the thrill of chance. We all should learn to live in peace and harmony. (But when we do eventually go to war, I know which side is going to win. Hint: it’s the side that doesn’t randomly jump on places where their might be bombs.)

Globesweeper manages to muddle this issue even further, taking the Minesweeper format and placing it a on sphere. Which, it turns out, really reduces the need for guessing, but doesn’t eliminate it. That is, until you find the extraordinary triangular mode.
